decisions.reason: As a resin injection unit closely aligned with the firm's core application-equipment business, it still merits continuation, though the lack of recent visibility suggests some review risk if sales stayed niche.
The automatic airless spray gun fits the company's established coating portfolio and industrial customer base well, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
This air-assisted airless spray gun line covers several models and customer needs, which makes it the most defensible product family to keep in the range.
The data logger is the least central to the firm's mechanical core and, if uptake has remained limited, management would likely reallocate resources to core equipment and newer development projects.
